summary: Record how a source states a number, and carry the CRediT contributor roles.
why: Run-04 declared 25 of its 61 typed gaps as INTERVAL_NOT_EXPRESSIBLE, each saying the source marks the value as approximate while the records carry an exact bound pair; run-05 declared one for a temperature stated only as above a threshold. Decision 15 puts optional enum ValueQualification on metrology's Quantified mixin beside value_upper: EXACT, APPROXIMATE, OPEN_LOWER_BOUND, OPEN_UPPER_BOUND, ORDER_OF_MAGNITUDE. An open bound leaves its absent end unset, which the shape already permitted. QUDT, UCUM, ISO 80000 and the VIM carry no term for how a source qualifies a stated number, so the enum is local and invention_search says so. Run-04 also declared 2 TYPE_ABSENT gaps for the contribution each author is credited with. Decision 16 adds enum ContributorRole, the fourteen CRediT roles of ANSI/NISO Z39.104-2022 with their own definitions plus a local OTHER, on optional slot contribution_role, on the new Contribution mixin, worn by the new ContributionRelation whose relation_type is the new CONTRIBUTED_TO. CRediT has no classes, so both shape names are invented and recorded. Both packs are additive at 0.3.0, the rites are unchanged, and paper-v4's frozen cells read them by git show.
